text.text: It's 11 a.m. at Copy Corner. Dona Rosa smiles. "Here's your presentation!" Ten colorful pages! 📄✨ Maya sends a message: "THANK YOU!!! 💚"
It's 12:05. Dona Rosa sends a message: "Sorry, the shop isn't open now! 🔒" Oh no... 😬 Maya answers fast: "No problem! We're going to draw the presentation! I have my pencils!" ✏️

scenes.alt: A mãe leva o aluno de carro, com o cartaz
O aluno no ônibus cheio, com o cartaz amassado

text.text: Mom waits in the car. "Thank you for Tuesday! Your poster goes in my car. It's too big for the bus!" 🚗 The poster is flat and perfect.
Mom cleans the garage... alone. 😤 "Sorry, I'm busy! Take the bus!" On the bus, there are a lot of people. Your poster is [[crumpled|amassado]] now. 🚌😩

messages: What time are the judges visiting your stand?
tasks.pt: Confira a agenda (📅) e responda à sua mãe.

outcomes.tip: O horário está marcado (a Ms. Lima disse): They're visiting.
O grupo da Bia (o seu) é às 3:15.

fallback.tip: Responda: They're visiting our stand at 3:15.

scenes.alt: A chegada à escola para montar o estande

text.text: It's 1 p.m. Everybody is here: Bia, Maya, Kauã... and Davi, with the table! He's on time today! 😄 Together, you set up the stand.
It's 1:55 p.m. Where's Davi? The fair opens in five minutes! 😱 Then the door opens: Davi runs in with the table on his back. "Sorry, sorry!" 🏃

messages: Hi, kids! I have a [[speaker|caixa de som]] for your stand. 🔊
tasks.pt: Ofereça ajuda na hora.

outcomes.tip: Oferta na hora: I'll help you!

fallback.tip: Ofereça: I'll help you!

scenes.alt: O estande do grupo, com o cartaz e a maquete

text.text: Your poster is big and colorful: "Vila Serena in 2050", with flying buses, solar houses and a lot of trees! 🎨
No markers... so your poster is in blue pen. 🖊️ Kauã looks at it. "Very... blue." 😂
And it's [[crumpled|amassado]]. Bia puts books on it. 📚
Everybody is in green... and you're in BLUE! Ms. Lima laughs. "You promise... and you wear blue!" 😂
Your stand is in the gym. 🏫
Your stand is in the courtyard. The wind gets stronger and stronger... 🌬️
It's 2 p.m. The fair is open! 🎉

messages: Hello, everybody! 🎉 Now the judges visit the stands. The prizes are at 5:30, in the gym!
{name}! When are the prizes? [[I'm selling cookies!|Estou vendendo biscoitos!]] 🍪
tasks.pt: Leia a mensagem da professora.

reply: That's the judges at our stand! 😅
outcomes.tip: 3:15 é a visita dos jurados. Os prêmios são às 5:30.
Os prêmios são às 5:30, no ginásio (gym).

scenes.alt: No ginásio, o estande firme; lá fora, árvores balançam com o vento
No pátio, o vento leva os cartazes e o Davi corre atrás

text.text: 3 p.m. Outside, the wind is very strong! 🌬️ People from the courtyard run into the gym with their posters. Your stand is OK. Bia smiles. "Good idea, {name}!" 😎

3 p.m. WHOOSH! 🌬️ The wind takes your posters! Davi runs after them. Kauã holds the cookies. Bia holds the table. 😱 Two minutes later, Davi is back with the posters: "[[Got them!|Peguei!]]" 🏃 Bia uses a lot of tape on them. 📎

messages: [[The judges are coming!|Os jurados estão chegando!]] 😬
My papers... my phone... my water... 😅
tasks.pt: Você vê o que vai acontecer. Avise a Maya!

outcomes.tip: Você está vendo o perigo: é evidência, então use going to: You're going to drop...

fallback.tip: Avise: Watch out, Maya! You're going to drop your papers!

scenes.alt: A Maya apresenta para os jurados no estande

text.text: The judges are here. 📋 Maya [[takes a deep breath|respira fundo]]... and she talks!
"In 2050, people will travel by flying bus! The houses will have solar panels. And there will be a lot of trees in Vila Serena!" 🌳
She shows the colorful presentation. 📄✨ The judges smile.
She shows the presentation, all in pencil. One judge smiles. "Wow, you can draw!" ✏️
At 5:30, in the gym: "And the prize for The Most Creative Stand goes to... Bia's group!" 🏅🎉 Maya hugs you. "Thank you, {name}!" 💚

messages: Let's get ice cream tomorrow afternoon! 🍦 Who's going to pay? 😄
tasks.pt: Ofereça na hora. (Lembre: de manhã, a avó.)

outcomes.tip: A Maya falou sorvete (ice cream).
Sem expressão de tempo, I'm paying parece agora. Oferta na hora: I'll pay.

fallback.tip: Ofereça: I'll pay for the ice cream!

tasks.alt: A foto do grupo com a medalha

tasks.pt: Agora é você, de verdade: escreva os SEUS planos para o fim de semana, em 5 frases, com pelo menos 3 expressões de tempo diferentes. O montador ajuda em até 2 frases.

example: On Saturday morning, I'm meeting my grandma at the bus station. 👵
In the afternoon, I'm going to get ice cream with my friends. 🍦
I think it'll be a great weekend!

close.tomorrow: Grandma arrives at 10 a.m. 👵 Ice cream in the afternoon! 🍦
